slider_input() renders an accessible range slider with live numeric readout—ideal for model parameters like temperature or confidence thresholds. { "type": "slider_input", "label": "Temperature", "value": 0.7, "min_val": 0, "max_val": 1, "step": 0.1, "name": "temperature" }
Parameter Type Description label, value, name str, number, str Slider label, initial numeric value, and form key. min_val, max_val, step number Range bounds and step increment (defaults 0, 100, 1).
